title: Nasi lemak
intro: Nasi lemak is Malaysia's much-loved rice plate, built around grains cooked in coconut milk and fragrant aromatics. What makes it so good is the spread of contrasting toppings served alongside: salty crisp anchovies, crunchy peanuts, a soft-boiled egg, cooling cucumber and a hit of chilli sambal, all eaten together in one mouthful.
